# Vibrant Gradient Presets Catalog (382 Presets)

`fractalthemer` provides **382 vibrant, named gradient presets** that can be activated as the application viewport background or sampled interactively in the theme drawer.

---

---

## 💻 Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import { themeState, GRADIENT_PRESETS } from 'fractalthemer';

// Activate a gradient by slug ID
themeState.setGradient('omolon');

// Access all presets
console.log('Available gradients:', GRADIENT_PRESETS.length);
```
